cards.example_en: Teachers monitor the hallway during the lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 老师们在午休时间监视走廊。

cards.example_en: Inside the cartoon, a friendly monster helps children find their home.
cards.example_zh: 动画片里，一只友善的怪物帮助孩子们找到家。

cards.example_en: Salt water damaged the motor of our small fishing boat.
cards.example_zh: 咸水损坏了我们那艘小渔船的发动机。

cards.example_en: Every Saturday my uncle rides a motorcycle to the market.
cards.example_zh: 每个星期六，我叔叔都骑摩托车去市场。

cards.example_en: Travel through this mountainous area is slow but the views are beautiful.
cards.example_zh: 穿越这一多山地区虽然慢，但景色非常美。

cards.example_en: At noon the cook with a thick moustache served us hot noodles.
cards.example_zh: 中午，那位留着浓密小胡子的厨师给我们端上了热面条。

cards.example_en: If you multiply six by four, the answer is twenty-four.
cards.example_zh: 如果你把六乘以四，答案就是二十四。

cards.example_en: Mum packed fruit and bread for our picnic by the river.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈为我们的河边野餐装好了水果和面包。

cards.example_en: The play ends with a murder, so younger pupils should not watch.
cards.example_zh: 这出戏以一场谋杀结束，低年级学生不适合看。

cards.example_en: Daily swimming built muscle in his arms and back.
cards.example_zh: 每天游泳让他的手臂和背部长出了肌肉。

cards.example_en: A wild mushroom grew beside the path after three rainy days.
cards.example_zh: 连着下了三天雨以后，小路边长出了一朵野蘑菇。

cards.example_en: After lunch Grandpa takes a short nap in his armchair.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，爷爷在扶手椅里小睡一会儿。

cards.example_en: The nasty weather cancelled our outdoor PE lesson.
cards.example_zh: 恶劣的天气让我们的室外体育课取消了。

cards.example_en: This young runner is nationally known for winning three races.
cards.example_zh: 这位年轻的赛跑选手因赢得三场比赛而全国闻名。

cards.example_en: The naughty puppy pulled the washing off the line.
cards.example_zh: 那只调皮的小狗把晾着的衣服扯了下来。

cards.example_en: There is a nearby shop.
cards.example_zh: 附近有一家商店。

cards.example_en: Keep your desk neat.
cards.example_zh: 保持桌面整洁。

cards.example_en: She threaded the needle.
cards.example_zh: 她把线穿过了针。

cards.example_en: Birds built a nest in the tree.
cards.example_zh: 鸟在树上筑了巢。

cards.example_en: Our best shot hit the net and never reached the goal.
cards.example_zh: 我们最好的一脚打在网上，球没有进。

cards.example_en: When my pen broke, the nib snapped and I borrowed Amy's pen.
cards.example_zh: 我的钢笔坏了，笔尖断了，于是我借了埃米的笔。

cards.example_en: My niece loves drawing.
cards.example_zh: 我侄女喜欢画画。

cards.example_en: I prefer non-fiction about animals to long adventure stories.
cards.example_zh: 比起长篇冒险故事，我更喜欢关于动物的非小说类作品。

cards.example_en: Birds fly to northern lakes when spring arrives.
cards.example_zh: 春天来临时，鸟儿会飞向北方的湖泊。

cards.example_en: Please notify the office if you cannot join the school trip.
cards.example_zh: 如果你不能参加学校旅行，请通知办公室。

cards.example_en: They visited a nuclear museum.
cards.example_zh: 他们参观了一座核博物馆。

cards.example_en: Squirrels hid every nut they found under the oak tree.
cards.example_zh: 松鼠把找到的每一颗坚果都藏到了橡树下面。

cards.example_en: All players must obey the rules during the basketball game.
cards.example_zh: 所有球员在篮球比赛中都必须遵守规则。

cards.example_en: Through a telescope at the observatory, we looked at bright stars.
cards.example_zh: 我们在天文台用望远镜观看明亮的星星。

cards.example_en: For dinner the cook fried an octopus and served it with rice.
cards.example_zh: 晚餐时，厨师炸了一只章鱼，配米饭端上来。

cards.example_en: An odd noise came from the fridge at midnight.
cards.example_zh: 半夜冰箱里传来一阵奇怪的响声。

cards.example_en: An official explained the new rule.
cards.example_zh: 一位官员解释了新规定。

cards.example_en: It is important to believe in oneself when learning a new sport.
cards.example_zh: 学习一项新运动时，相信自己很重要。

cards.example_en: Oops, I dropped the plate of noodles on the kitchen floor.
cards.example_zh: 哎呀，我把一盘面条掉在了厨房的地板上。

cards.example_en: The contest is a good opportunity to show your speaking skills.
cards.example_zh: 这次比赛是展示你口语能力的好机会。

cards.example_en: At the concert our school orchestra played a cheerful piece.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会上，我们学校的管弦乐队演奏了一首轻快的曲子。

cards.example_en: We ate ordinary bread and soup for dinner at home.
cards.example_zh: 我们在家晚饭吃了普通的面包和汤。

cards.example_en: The heart is a vital organ.
cards.example_zh: 心脏是重要器官。

cards.example_en: The aid organisation brought clean water to the flooded streets.
cards.example_zh: 援助组织给被淹的街道送来了干净的水。

cards.example_en: You ought to bring your book tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 你明天应该把书带来。

cards.example_en: The captain will outline the match plan before kickoff.
cards.example_zh: 队长会在开球前概述比赛计划。

cards.example_en: Eight people can sit around the oval table in the dining room.
cards.example_zh: 八个人可以围坐在餐厅里的椭圆形桌子旁。

cards.example_en: Before dinner he hung his overcoat on a hook by the door.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭前，他把大衣挂在门边的钩子上。

cards.example_en: Bright music from the overture filled the hall before the opera.
cards.example_zh: 歌剧开始前，序曲明快的音乐充满了大厅。

cards.example_en: People need oxygen to live.
cards.example_zh: 人需要氧气才能生存。

cards.example_en: A package arrived this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上到了一个包裹。

cards.example_en: Inside this pamphlet you can find the city museum's opening hours.
cards.example_zh: 这本小册子里可以找到市博物馆的开放时间。

cards.example_en: Heat the pan before you add oil.
cards.example_zh: 加油前先把锅烧热。

cards.example_en: Along the main street, a colourful parade moved slowly past us.
cards.example_zh: 一支色彩缤纷的游行队伍沿着大街从我们身边缓缓走过。

cards.example_en: She found a part-time job at the bookshop after school.
cards.example_zh: 她放学后在书店找到了一份兼职工作。

word.example_en: He can cook a meal by himself.
I hope you enjoy yourself at the party.
word.example_zh: 希望你在聚会上玩得开心。
